data.one_liner: WalletConnect toolkit for wallet applications to handle authentication, sessions, and payments.
data.what_it_does: Provides tools for building crypto wallets using the WalletConnect Network. It supports session management, pairing, request handling, and built-in WalletConnect Pay capabilities.
use_when: You are developing a mobile cryptocurrency wallet app in Flutter.
You need to integrate WalletConnect session proposals, approvals, and transaction signing.
You need to handle crypto payments using WalletConnect Pay.
avoid_when: You are building a dApp rather than a wallet (use appropriate dApp SDKs instead).
You do not need Web3 functionality or blockchain integrations in your app.
strengths: Streamlines wallet integration with WalletConnect Network.
Built-in support for WalletConnect Pay and crypto payment flows.
Comprehensive session management and event handling capabilities.
weaknesses: Requires proper handling of complex Web3 security parameters and CAIP-10 accounts.
data.setup_notes: Requires initialization with a project ID and metadata, plus configuration for targeted chains and accounts.
